claim: Biometric proof-of-personhood (Worldcoin/World ID) has scaled enrollment to tens of millions AND carries documented regulatory/privacy failure modes (suspensions or bans incl. Kenya 2023, Spain/Portugal 2024, Brazil 2025; non-rotatable biometric risk)
Social-graph proof-of-personhood (Duniter/Ğ1 Web of Trust, Relative Theory of Money) has run the longest-lived per-person dividend issuance (since 2017), at small scale and small purchasing power

Court/adjudication-based proof-of-personhood (Proof of Humanity) operated a registry whose paired UBI token collapsed in value and whose governance suffered documented capture/fork conflict (Kleros cooperative post-mortem; interested-party source, label REPORTED where applicable)
No deployed proof-of-personhood approach has simultaneously demonstrated uniqueness, privacy, and scale; durable sybil resistance at millions of users remains undemonstrated
UBI pilot evidence (Finland 2017–18; GiveDirectly Kenya RCT; Stockton SEED; Alaska PFD) shows small-to-null labor-supply effects at modest transfer sizes
No pilot reaches the living-wage regime; extrapolation of labor-supply findings to full living-wage UBI is unsupported in either direction
Every deployed crypto-UBI to date failed on the demand side (value collapse or acceptance collapse), never on the distribution side

Protocol-level monetary levers (issuance schedules, demurrage, fee recycling, reserve backing) can sustain a UBI's real purchasing power while preserving work incentives — CENTRAL OPEN CHALLENGE; quantitative success criteria to be finalized in the blueprint chapter (must include a purchasing-power criterion, a scale criterion, velocity/sink data, and a labor-market criterion)

Non-currency assets (equities, property) can be brought into the redistribution loop via tokenization plus Harberger-style levies / demurrage-on-property / protocol treasury acquisition, funding a per-person dividend

To our knowledge no published protocol-level mechanism design couples non-currency asset redistribution to a per-person dividend with a stability analysis and enumerated attack surface (nearest prior art: on-chain Harberger/COST for digital assets incl. EIP-5320, CityDAO's unoperationalized land-tax exploration, GoodDollar's currency-yield reserve, state-run sovereign-wealth dividends)
verifier: prior-art search 2026-07-29 (~12 English-language web searches; deeper SSRN/NBER + French monnaie-libre pass scheduled before this claim is asserted in blueprint prose)

claim: Demurrage stimulates circulation only where captive demand exists (Wörgl: municipal tax acceptance); as a voluntary open token it is adoption-dominated by non-decaying alternatives (Freicoin)
Grassroots Economics' Sarafu community currencies (Kenya) are the principal living demurrage-adjacent deployment, operating within captive local-demand loops

There exists a levy rate τ, wrapped-asset base W, and token velocity v at which the Commonwealth Protocol's dividend sustains real purchasing power over N years for M verified persons with zero issuance — and Rings 1–2 (protocol-native + tokenized financial assets) alone can reach that region without real property. If the flow-of-funds model shows Ring 3 (real property, requiring jurisdictional adoption) is load-bearing, that finding is reported as the dossier's answer

Model parameter ranges — levy rate tau 0.5–3% viable (>3% historically evasion-prone), real yield 1.5%, retention rho 20% — are author engineering judgments with stated reasoning, not empirical findings

Success tiers for C13 — poverty-relevant $270/yr (GiveDirectly transfer scale), floor $2,000/yr (Alaska-dividend / global-wealth-ceiling scale), living wage ~$10,000+/yr jurisdiction-indexed — are author-chosen thresholds anchored to cited magnitudes
